# Component reference

Kit **1.0**, protocol **1**. Every app describes its views with these components; the client renders them with the kit. Apps never style: they pick semantic tokens only (spacing, text styles, palette roles, radii). The design is in `docs/architecture/ui-system.md`.

## Conventions

- **Lua**: `ui.X { positional, prop = value, slotName = node, onEvent = handler }`. Positional entries are children, or the component's *positional prop* (shown below). Constructors return plain node tables.
- **Values**: a prop is a literal, a **ref** (`w.client.search`, a source field, `r.title` in a row template) or a call of the closed expression set (`ui.concat`, `ui.when`, `ui.fmt.*`, see [Expressions](#expressions)).
- **Bindings** (`Binding`): two-way props. Pass a ref the control also writes (`w.client.x`, `source:bind("field")`), never a plain value.
- **Keys**: interactive nodes need an explicit `key`; test ids derive from keys (`app-key-key-...`), skipping auto keys (`_0`), slot names and the window root. A row template contributes `row-<rowKey>`.
- **Handlers**: a Lua function, a `ui.act.*` action (runs on the client), or a list mixing both. Nothing executable crosses the wire.
- **Tiers**: Tier 1 is final. Tier 2 and 3 are **placeholders**: the name exists, any prop is accepted, the schema is written when the first app that needs it is designed.

## Layout

### Stack

Lays children out along one axis. `VStack` and `HStack` are `axis` sugar in the Luau constructors.

Tier 1 · since 1.0

`ui.VStack` is `axis = "v"`, `ui.HStack` is `axis = "h"`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | `v` \| `h` |  | `"v"` |  |
| `spacing` | spacing 0..8 |  |  |  |
| `align` | `start` \| `center` \| `end` \| `stretch` |  |  |  |
| `justify` | `start` \| `center` \| `end` \| `between` \| `around` |  |  |  |
| `wrap` | boolean |  |  | Horizontal stacks only: flow onto new lines. |

| Slot | Lua key | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | positional | positional entries: any number of nodes |

## Advanced

### ChatTranscript

An agent chat bound to a `thread` source: streaming messages, reasoning (collapsed), a one-line summary of each turn's activity (counts, not tool lists), permission prompts (allow once, always, deny), errors, the session bar (mode, model and effort, slash commands, context usage) and a composer with a stop button. The thread's data arrives over `/agui`, not through `data.patch`: the source only names the thread and the agent.

Tier 2 · since 1.0 · interactive (needs an explicit `key`)

Accessibility: role `log`. 

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `thread` | source | yes |  | A `thread` source: `params` are the thread id (`thread`) and the agent (`agent`). |
| `placeholder` | string |  |  | The composer's placeholder. |
| `composer` | boolean |  | `true` | `false` shows the transcript without a composer. |

| Event | Lua prop | Payload | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `send` | `onSend` | `text: string` | The person sent a message (informational: the client already sent it to the agent). |
| `stop` | `onStop` | none | The person stopped the running turn. |

## Common props, events and slots

Every node accepts these. A component's own prop of the same name overrides the common one.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `testid` | string |  |  | Overrides the derived test id. |
| `label` | string |  |  | Accessible name. |
| `hint` | string |  |  | Accessible description. |
| `hidden` | boolean |  |  | Removed from layout and the accessibility tree. |
| `disabled` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `padding` | spacing \| [`Insets`](#insets) |  |  | Spacing units of 4 pt: `0..=8` or per edge. |
| `frame` | `fill` \| [`Frame`](#frame) |  |  | Layout, not styling: `"fill"` or min/ideal/max in pt, clamped to the window. |
| `grow` | number |  |  | Flex grow factor. |
| `align` | `start` \| `center` \| `end` \| `stretch` |  |  | Alignment in the parent stack. |
| `background` | [`SurfaceToken`](#surfacetoken) |  |  |  |
| `foreground` | [`LabelToken`](#labeltoken) |  |  |  |
| `tint` | [`PaletteToken`](#palettetoken) |  |  | Re-points the accent for the subtree. |
| `corner` | [`RadiusToken`](#radiustoken) |  |  |  |
| `help` | string |  |  | Tooltip. |
| `shortcut` | string |  |  | `"cmd+n"`: shown in menus, active while the window is focused. |
| `drag` | [`Drag`](#drag) |  |  | Makes the node draggable. Always give it a non-drag path (`contextMenu`). |
| `drop` | [`Drop`](#drop) |  |  | Makes the node a drop target. |
| `animation` | `default` \| `none` |  |  |  |
| `tag` | any |  |  | The selection value of a row, tab or picker item. |
| `span` | integer |  |  | Grid child: columns spanned. |
| `rowStart` | integer |  |  | Grid child: start row. |
| `colStart` | integer |  |  | Grid child: start column. |

| Event | Lua prop | Payload | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appear` | `onAppear` | none |  |
| `disappear` | `onDisappear` | none |  |
| `drop` | `onDrop` | `type: string`, `payload?: any`, `target: any` |  |

| Slot | Lua key | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `contextMenu` | `contextMenu` | Menu items for long-press / right-click. |
| `fallback` | `fallback` | Rendered by a client whose kit predates the component. |
| `tabItem` | `tabItem` | at most 1; On a `TabView` child: the tab's label, icon and badge. |

| `sync` | string |  |  | When the value is written back: `change`, `blur`, `submit` or `debounce:<ms>`. |

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |

## Expressions

A prop value is a literal, a ref, or a call of this closed set. Pure, presentation-only, no loops, no recursion, no I/O: it cannot hang or exfiltrate and costs at most its node count. Anything else is computed on the host.

| Wire name | Lua | Arguments | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `not` | `ui.negate` | 1 | Boolean negation. |
| `and` | `ui.all` | 1+ | True when every argument is truthy. |
| `or` | `ui.any` | 1+ | True when any argument is truthy. |
| `eq` | `ui.eq` | 2 | Strict equality. |
| `ne` | `ui.ne` | 2 | Strict inequality. |
| `lt` | `ui.lt` | 2 | Less than. |
| `gt` | `ui.gt` | 2 | Greater than. |
| `add` | `ui.add` | 2 | Number addition. |
| `sub` | `ui.sub` | 2 | Number subtraction. |
| `if` | `ui.when` | 3 | `if(cond, then, else)`. |
| `coalesce` | `ui.coalesce` | 1+ | The first argument that is not null or empty. |
| `concat` | `ui.concat` | 1+ | Concatenate the arguments as text. |
| `len` | `ui.len` | 1 | Length of a string or list. |
| `isEmpty` | `ui.isEmpty` | 1 | True for null, an empty string or an empty list. |
| `upper` | `ui.upper` | 1 | Upper-case text. |
| `lower` | `ui.lower` | 1 | Lower-case text. |
| `fmt.number` | `ui.fmt.number` | 1..2 | Format a number in the viewer's locale. |
| `fmt.currency` | `ui.fmt.currency` | 1..3 | Format money in the viewer's locale. |
| `fmt.percent` | `ui.fmt.percent` | 1..2 | Format a ratio as a percentage. |
| `fmt.bytes` | `ui.fmt.bytes` | 1..2 | Format a byte count (KB, MB, ...). |
| `fmt.date` | `ui.fmt.date` | 1..2 | Format a date or instant in the viewer's locale and time zone. |
| `fmt.time` | `ui.fmt.time` | 1..2 | Format a time of day. |
| `fmt.dateTime` | `ui.fmt.dateTime` | 1..2 | Format a date and time. |
| `fmt.relative` | `ui.fmt.relative` | 1..2 | Relative time ("2 minutes ago"), ticking from `env.now`. |
| `fmt.plural` | `ui.fmt.plural` | 2 | Pick a plural form: `fmt.plural(n, {one, other})`. |
| `fmt.list` | `ui.fmt.list` | 1..2 | Join a list ("a, b and c"). |

**Refs** point into: `client.*` (client-managed state), `state.*` (app and window state), `src.<id>.<field>` (a source), `row.*` (the current row, inside a row template), `route.*` (inside a navigation destination) and `env.sizeClass`, `env.heightClass`, `env.locale`, `env.timeZone`, `env.scheme`, `env.now`. A `Binding` prop only accepts the writable namespaces: `client`, `state`, `src` and `row`.

**Client actions** (`ui.act.*`): `set(ref, value)`, `toggle(ref)`, `push(route, stack?)`, `pop()`, `popToRoot()`, `focus(key)`, `scrollTo(key)`, `copy(text)`, `emit(event?, payload?)`, `seq{...}`.

## Protocol methods

JSON-RPC 2.0 over `/rpc`, by-name params objects.

| Method | Direction | Kind | Params | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session.hello` | client to host | request | `SessionHello` | `SessionWelcome` | Handshake, version negotiation, formatting environment. |
| `view.open` | client to host | request | `ViewOpen` | `ViewSnapshot` | Create or resume a view: tree, state, client state, declarations and the first data. |
| `view.sync` | client to host | request | `ViewRef` | `ViewSnapshot` | Full resync, after a gap or a failed op. |
| `view.event` | client to host | request | `ViewEvent` | `EventAck` | A user event. The ack arrives after every op and patch it caused. |
| `state.set` | client to host | request | `StateSet` | `WriteAck` | Two-way write to a server state path. |
| `row.set` | client to host | request | `RowSet` | `WriteAck` | Two-way write to a field of a bound row. |
| `row.restore` | client to host | request | `RowRestore` | `WriteAck` | Undo: restore a kept revision of a bound field. |
| `source.set` | client to host | request | `SourceSet` | `SourcePatch` | Change a source's params and/or its visible window. |
| `view.close` | client to host | request | `ViewRef` | `null` | Flush drafts, then destroy the instance. |
| `client.state` | client to host | notification | `ClientState` |  | Mirror of synced and persisted client entries. |
| `view.resize` | client to host | notification | `ViewResize` |  | The window was resized (only if the app reads `w.env.*`). |
| `view.visibility` | client to host | notification | `ViewVisibility` |  | The window was hidden or shown. |
| `session.bye` | client to host | notification | `Empty` |  | The client is going away. |
| `view.tree` | host to client | notification | `ViewTree` |  | A full tree replace. |
| `view.ops` | host to client | notification | `ViewOps` |  | Keyed structural ops. |
| `data.patch` | host to client | notification | `DataPatch` |  | Per-binding values and row windows. |
| `client.set` | host to client | notification | `ClientSet` |  | The app drives client-managed state. |
| `view.command` | host to client | notification | `ViewCommand` |  | Imperative one-shots: toast, focus, scrollTo, announce, copy, openUrl, haptic, closeWindow. |
| `view.error` | host to client | notification | `ViewError` |  | A render or validation failure; the last good tree stays. |
| `view.closed` | host to client | notification | `ViewClosed` |  | The instance is gone. |
| `theme.set` | host to client | notification | `ThemeSet` |  | The host theme. |
| `window.open` | host to client | notification | `WindowOpen` |  | An app asked for a window (`app:openWindow`): open it, or bring it forward. |

Catalogue size: Tier 1: 49, Tier 2: 12, Tier 3: 9.
